limitations: Live run 2026-09-26 on origin/main 4c7875d, tarball aiur-khala-0.1.0.tgz, Claude Code 2.1.283, agent-launched in tmux (not an ordinary user-started CLI), user default trust settings, no permission bypass.

The shipped internal server composes the Claude session route with claudeCapabilities(null), whose acknowledgement is unknown, and its read port always refuses. Every hook pull and khala_read is therefore refused as unproven before any batch or token exists, so the receipt route cannot be exercised live on this build.
interactiveClaudeCapabilities and CLAUDE_INTERACTIVE_PROVEN are not consulted by the internal server or the local harness inspection, so adding a proven pair alone would not open delivery.
Token-dependent scenarios (framing, no later call, missing, duplicate, wrong token, wrong binding, wrong generation) were not observed because no batch was ever delivered.
Setup ran with a PATH that omitted OpenCode 1.15.6 and Codex: an installed untested OpenCode refuses setup for every harness, and Codex was excluded to keep shared Aiur worker config untouched.
Offline conformance is component evidence, never a support claim.
